baseline.note: Behavioural golden standard only. Historical internal utility/exposure numbers are evidence, not targets.

sources.note: Cumulative export. Only the e75f... grand-live-v6 session is admitted here; the older 70b... grand-live-v5 session is explicitly excluded.

Cumulative export containing the ec223... session. That session contains more than one logical run, so checkpoints are selected explicitly by sequence/stateHash rather than treating sessionId as one run.

excludedSessions.reason: grand-live-v5 session from 2026-08-14; not representative of the v1.0.2/grand-live-v6 golden baseline.

runs.note: Run reviewed as globally solid: clean C1/C2/C3 policy, successful SP hunt, aggressive-but-bounded C4, then sensible Grand Live conversion. Individual unmatched manual overrides are not promoted as golden checkpoints.
First logical run inside the long-lived ec223... logging session. Reviewed as one of the strong v6 runs; explicit sequence bounds prevent accidental mixing with the later reset.
Second logical run inside ec223..., beginning after the C1 reset around sequence 220. Reviewed as a strong v6 run including real carryover, deep C4 progression and Grand Live conversion.

checkpoints.reason: Representative C1 low-cost technique choice followed by the user; protects ordinary resource ranking without asserting any internal utility number.
Accepted C1 technique ranking on the validated run. Useful guard against regressions in ordinary colour/resource tie-breaking.
Accepted C2 close-path technique choice before the section song decision.
Accepted C2 visible-song choice on the validated run; preserves structural song ranking rather than numeric exposure values.
C3 SP3 hunt remains active after a miss; the chosen visible filler matched the recommendation. This is evidence for the useful shape of HUNT, not an oracle for the old three-miss threshold.
Accepted continuation of the C3 SP3 hunt after a filler purchase. P3b2 may change the explanation, but should not casually destroy this successful ordinary hunt path.
The SP3 hunt succeeds and Grow Up and Shine is bought as recommended. Structural target acquisition must remain dominant without requiring a fake stat-equivalent Friendship/SP exposure.
Accepted post-target close-path technique choice; useful to detect broad ranking regressions after HUNT exits.
Second accepted close-path technique after the SP3 target.
Validated C4 run contains a positive expose-and-carry terminal branch here. Preserve the existence of an aggressive C4 path; do not preserve the historical exposure/net-value arithmetic itself.
Early C4 terminal projection explicitly recommends continuing toward another page; preserves the strong-run PUSH side without freezing its legacy exposure scalar.
Accepted deep-C4 continuation with near-certain terminal reach. Protects bounded aggression before the later STOP transition.
Another accepted cycle-4 PUSH in the validated run; useful paired evidence against a blanket conservative terminal policy.
The same strong run later transitions to STOP when the deep continuation becomes materially worse. Protects bounded, not unconditional, C4 aggression.
Late-C4 terminal STOP with high page reach but poor continuation value; ensures future layered robustness can still stop despite reachability.
Accepted fifth-song C4 purchase after paying through the deep cycle. Guards against becoming uniformly over-conservative in C4.
Accepted Grand Live conversion purchase; terminal stock is for conversion, not generic reserve utility.
Real C1 song-page carry into C2, matched by the user. This is a high-value golden checkpoint for preserving carryover semantics.
Accepted early-C4 technique choice from a run later reviewed as strong.
Accepted Fanfare purchase during a deep, successful C4 path. Protects structural Friendship prioritisation.
C1 reset confirms this is a second logical run inside the same logging session; accepted ordinary technique ranking.
Accepted C3 technique choice in the second ec223 logical run.
Accepted deep-C4 technique step. The reviewed run reached seven C4 songs, so P3b2 must not regress into a blanket STOP policy.
Second validated run reaches seven C4 songs then rejects an unsafe/depleted deep continuation. Complements the accepted deep-PUSH checkpoints.
Accepted Grand Live conversion purchase near the end of the second validated run.

knownNonGoldenPatterns.reason: A user click with matchedRecommendation=false is historical evidence, not a golden solver decision, even when it occurs inside an accepted run.
The raw three-miss HUNT threshold and its exposure-based continuation rule are explicitly under P3b2 redesign and must not be frozen as golden behaviour.
Historical friendshipExposure / training-exposure / net-value numbers are diagnostics only; P3b2 is expected to change or remove their decision weight.
Later C4 STOP cases identified as suspicious/buggy (for example the 41/51/51/45/72 state) are regression targets to fix, not accepted v1.0.2 oracle states.
